newsitem.title: USA: Cronos president, two others resign.
newsitem.headline: Cronos president, two others resign.

text.p: Cronos Group on Wednesday said its president, Nigel Stribley, and two other senior executives were resigning from the company.
Company officials were not immediately available for comment on the reasons for the resignations.

In February, Cronos, which leases shipping containers to about 300 ocean carriers and transport operators, said it was cooperating with an investigation by the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission regarding allegations made by its independent auditor, Arthur Andersen.
Andersen resigned as Cronos' auditor on February 3. The company later named Moore Stephens as its head auditor. Its first-quarter results are expected to be released this week.

In addition to Stribley, Danny Wong, vice president of the Asia Pacific region, and Geoff Mornard, vice president of the Europe, Middle East and Africa regions, are departing, the company said in Wednesday's statement.

Stephen Brocato, vice president of corporate affairs, has taken over as president effective immediately, the company said. Nico Sciacovelli has taken the position as vice president in Europe, the Middle East and Africa, and Harris Ho will replace Wong.
All three resigning officers will stay with Cronos for an unspecified transition period.
